reasoning_content:
GetFeature is returning a 400 exception. This is expected behavior for a new, empty database (since there's no plan data, GetFeature with the wrong or empty typename will fail, or the feature type might not exist in 5.2). In any case, GetCapabilities is working correctly and is returning the full list of layer definitions. The service is installed and functioning correctly. The DB is intentionally empty (since no plans have been uploaded). A 400 error on GetFeature against an empty database is not a sign of an installation failure.

Let me check the exception text to confirm it's a "not found" type error rather than a DB connectivity error.

action.command: grep -oE "<ows:ExceptionText>[^<]+" /tmp/gf3.xml | head -2; echo "=== confirm WFS layer list in capabilities (proves DB-backed layers resolved) ==="; timeout 40 curl -s "http://localhost:8080/xplan-services-wfs/services/wfs40?service=WFS&request=GetCapabilities&version=2.0.0" | grep -oE "<Name>[a-z0-9]+:[A-Za-z_0-9]+</Name>" | head -5
